title: feat: add quick action buttons to foreground service notification
body: ## Summary Adds Note, Mood, and Drink quick action buttons to the Android foreground service persistent notification (`QuickCaptureService.kt`). Previously, this notification was a plain text notification with no action buttons — only the separate Flutter-managed notification (from `flutter_local_notifications`) had buttons. **Changes:** - **`QuickCaptureService.kt`**: Added 3 `addAction()` calls (📝 Note, 😊 Mood, 💧 Drink) with `PendingIntent`s that open `MainActivity` with a `quick_action` extra. Bumped notification channel importance from `LOW` to `DEFAULT` (with `setSound(null, null)`) so buttons are visible without manual expansion. - **`MainActivity.kt`**: Added `onNewIntent` handler and a `com.hopeos.app/quick_action` MethodChannel to forward native notification action taps to Flutter. - **`notification_action_router.dart`**: Added a MethodChannel listener that receives native quick actions and routes them to the same capture modal handler used by `flutter_local_notifications`. ## Review & Testing Checklist for Human - [ ] Enable the foreground service in Settings and verify the persistent notification shows 3 action buttons (Note, Mood, Drink) - [ ] Tap each action button and verify the correct capture modal opens (Note sheet, Mood sheet, Drink dialog) - [ ] Verify tapping a button while the app is in the background brings the app to foreground with the correct modal - [ ] Confirm the notification doesn't produce sound (channel sound is disabled) - [ ] Test on a fresh install AND an upgrade — the channel importance change may not take effect on an existing channel (user may need to clear app data or manually adjust the notification channel in Android Settings) ### Notes - Android caps notification actions at 3 buttons — Note, Mood, and Drink were chosen to match the Flutter notification - The notification channel importance change from LOW to DEFAULT won't auto-apply on existing installs; the user may need to clear the notification channel in Settings > Apps > HopeOS > Notifications - 0 new lint warnings; 6 pre-existing `use_build_context_synchronously` infos unchanged - APK builds successfully (64.3 MB) Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/e05e0b70739041d7b8ddcb7848925217 Requested by: @ben200810-lang ---
